description: A spooling rule describes a certain way to store and retrieve
data from a defined storage facility.
Spooling rules can implement spooling to files in a certain
directory or spooling into a database, to an LDAP repository, etc.
A spooling context can contain multiple spooling rules.

attributes.name: name
description: Unique name of the rule.

attributes.name: url
description: An url, e.g. a spool directory, a database url etc.

attributes.name: option_func
description: Function pointer to a function to set any database specific options,
e.g. whether to do database recovery at startup or not.

attributes.name: startup_func
description: Function pointer to a startup function,
e.g. establishing a connection to a database.

attributes.name: shutdown_func
description: Function pointer to a shutdown function,
e.g. disconnecting from a database or closing file handles.

attributes.name: maintenance_func
description: Function pointer to a maintenance function for
- creating the database tables / directories in case of filebased spooling
- switching between spooling with/without history
- backup
- cleaning up / compressing database
- etc.

attributes.name: trigger_func
description: Function pointer to a trigger function.
A trigger function is used to trigger regular actions, e.g.
checkpointing and cleaning the transaction log in case of the
Berkeley DB or vacuuming in case of PostgreSQL.

attributes.name: transaction_func
description: Function pointer to a function beginning and ending transactions.

attributes.name: list_func
description: Pointer to a function reading complete lists (master lists)
from the spooling data source.

attributes.name: read_func
description: Pointer to a function reading a single object from the
spooling data source.

attributes.name: read_keys_func
description: Reads all keys from a spooling database
matching beginning with a certain pattern.
@see e.g. spool_berkeleydb_read_keys()

attributes.name: write_func
description: Pointer to a function writing a single object.

attributes.name: delete_func
description: Pointer to a function deleting a single object.

attributes.name: validate_func
description: Pointer to a function validating a single object.

attributes.name: validate_list_func
description: Pointer to a function validating a list of objects.

attributes.name: clientdata
description: Clientdata; any pointer, can be used to store and
reference rule specific data, e.g. file or database handles.
